analysis.known_events: Reconstruct expert sign transitions only at t>=2 from saved action1.. targets. No reconstruction or read of action0.
analysis.assignment: Each saved near-event frame assigned once to nearest known same-type event within5; ties use earlier event. Unmatched saved frames allowed only t<=6 and retained unresolved_boundary.
analysis.phase_definition: pre lag-5..-1, at lag0, post lag1..5; unresolved retains missing lag and event.
analysis.context_rule: Primary uses all saved union frames. Secondary removes saved near-opposite-type overlap; report both, no primary replacement.
analysis.direction_partition: All scored frames partitioned by strict sign; no epsilon. Neutral mismatches retained.
analysis.rate_denominators: Report wrong count/n_phase and wrong count/n_same_expert_sign separately; absent expert-sign class produces null conditional rate.
analysis.translation_error: Per-frame mean squared error of original float32 action dimensions0..2, using float64 arithmetic; no thresholds.
analysis.within_seed_control: For each direction/phase compare wrong frames to sign-correct frames with the same expert sign, and separately per demo when both groups exist. Conditional association, not same-state causal intervention.
analysis.cross_seed_same_frame: For each frame with at least1 directional-error seed and at least1 sign-correct seed, mean translation error of error seeds minus mean of correct seeds; exactly1 contrast per unique expert frame.
analysis.cross_seed_overlap: All3-seed directional-error intersection, union and Jaccard, all pairwise intersections; retain frame/demo/lag IDs for every common frame.
analysis.lags: All eleven integer offsets -5..5 with n/expert-class/direction counts and translation means; no per-event duplication or forward-filling.
analysis.flags: For each task/arm/event/context/phase/direction, within-seed wrong-minus-correct translation delta strictly positive in all3 valid seeds; null if any seed lacks either group. Descriptive, not significance/causal/training gate.
analysis.paired_arms: All B-A/B-C task/seed/event/context/phase comparisons of sign-error rate and translation MSE on identical phase frames; no outcome selection.
analysis.summaries: All tasks/seeds/arms/demos retained, empty groups null with counts; no cross-task pooled inference.
analysis.training_decision: No automatic loss/observation/budget change, SPT acceptance or checkpoint selection.

failure_rule: Stop on hash/role/matrix/IDs/shape/finite/bounds/saved-mask reconstruction mismatch or nonboundary unmatched frame; do not overwrite old outputs or relax gates.
